title: Cooling System & Water Pump Check
subtitle: Temp climb, sweet smells, and pump weep holes — inspect cold, never crack a hot system.
tone: Production EN coach (US/EU): warm mentor, visual-first, max 2 CTAs, progress %, mileage personalization, legal disclaimer every step, high-risk modal with Find a nearby shop cancel, step feedback Yes/No. Phase 3B cooling: hot cap ban; plastic impeller pumps shop-heavy.

prerequisites: Engine fully cold for reservoir/cap checks
parts_checklist: Shop: pump, thermostat, hoses, burp tools

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Some BMWs use electric water pumps with fail-safe limp modes — diagnosis is scan + specialist territory.
On many engines the water pump is tied to timing belt service — replace as a set when due.
High-mile cooling: plastic tanks, thermostat housings, and pump weep holes deserve a hard look.
EV/PHEV thermal loops are specialized — owner reservoir top-offs only if the manual shows them; pack loops are shop-only.
